remarks: Welcome to 8118 Bear Lake Road, where modern updates, year-round comfort, and lakeside living come together in one beautifully renovated property. Overlooking scenic Bear Lake with deeded lake access and a dock, this exceptional home is perfect as a full-time residence, vacation getaway, or an income producing Airbnb. Completely renovated from top to bottom, this home features a thoughtfully designed addition of approximately 1,100 square feet, creating a spacious primary suite complete with vaulted ceilings, a luxurious primary bathroom, and a relaxing retreat to unwind after a day on the lake. Enter through the rear entrance into a convenient mudroom and laundry area, ideal for everyday living. The beautifully updated kitchen offers modern finishes and flows seamlessly into the living space, creating an inviting atmosphere for entertaining family and friends. Recent improvements include new vinyl siding, a new roof, spray foam insulation, and four Fuji and Haier mini split systems that provide efficient heating and air conditioning throughout the home. Outside, you'll find a stunning 24 x 26 detached garage featuring beautiful custom vinyl wood door look, offering ample space for vehicles, recreational equipment, or additional storage. The garage is equipped with a Tesla charging station, providing added convenience for electric vehicle owners. Enjoy evenings relaxing in the hot tub or gathering around the beautiful fire pit while taking in the peaceful surroundings. The property offers the perfect balance of outdoor recreation and comfortable living with easy access to Bear Lake. For even more recreational opportunities, just down the road and offers a convenient public boat launch, making it easy to enjoy boating and fishing. Currently operating as a successful Airbnb, this property presents an outstanding opportunity for buyers looking to continue generating rental income or simply enjoy it as a private year-round residence.The home is being offered mostly furnished, with only a few personal items excluded, making it truly move in ready and allowing you to begin enjoying lake life immediately.
